subject: maths

concepts.title: Evaluation of Negative Exponents
concepts.definition: A non-zero integer raised to a negative power is equivalent to the reciprocal of that integer raised to the positive version of that power.
concepts.key_idea: Flip the base to the denominator to transform a negative exponent into a positive one.
question_patterns: evaluate 3^-2
find the value of 2 to the power -3
calculate the numerical value of 5^-1
what is the value of 10^-2
simplify and find the value of 4^-3

solution_steps.explain: Calculate the base raised to the negative power directly.

concepts.title: Multiplicative Inverse of Powers
concepts.definition: The multiplicative inverse of a power is another power with the same base such that their product equals one.
concepts.key_idea: The multiplicative inverse is found by reversing the sign of the exponent.
question_patterns: find the multiplicative inverse of 2^-4
what is the reciprocal of 5^3
calculate the inverse of a given power
express the multiplicative inverse in exponential form
determine the value that yields 1 when multiplied by the power

solution_steps.explain: Locate the exponent in the given power term.
Change the sign of the exponent to find the inverse power.

concepts.title: Expanded Form with Negative Exponents
concepts.definition: Writing a decimal number as a sum of its digits multiplied by corresponding powers of ten, including negative powers for decimal places.
concepts.key_idea: Decimal positions to the right of the point correspond to 10^-1, 10^-2, and so on.
question_patterns: expand 1425.36 using exponents
write the decimal number in expanded form
express the value as a sum of powers of 10
use negative exponents to expand the decimal part
show the positional value expansion of the number

solution_steps.explain: Determine the power of 10 associated with each digit's position.
Multiply each digit by its positional power of 10.
Combine all terms to show the complete expanded form.

concepts.title: Product Law of Exponents
concepts.definition: When multiplying two powers with the same base, the exponents are added while the base remains the same.
concepts.key_idea: Addition of exponents for multiplication of identical bases.
question_patterns: simplify 2^3 * 2^-5
multiply powers with the same base
express the product of 3^2 and 3^-4 in exponential form
calculate the result of a^m * a^n
combine terms using the product law of exponents

solution_steps.explain: Ensure both terms have the same base.
Sum the exponents of the terms being multiplied.

concepts.title: Quotient Law of Exponents
concepts.definition: When dividing two powers with the same base, the exponent of the divisor is subtracted from the exponent of the dividend.
concepts.key_idea: Subtraction of exponents for division of identical bases.
question_patterns: divide 5^8 by 5^3
simplify the ratio of two powers with the same base
express 2^5 / 2^-6 in power notation
calculate the quotient using exponent laws
what is the result of dividing a^m by a^n

solution_steps.explain: Ensure the dividend and divisor share the same base.
Subtract the exponent in the denominator from the exponent in the numerator.

concepts.title: Power of a Power Law
concepts.definition: Raising a power to another exponent results in a base raised to the product of the two exponents.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply exponents when a power is raised to another power.
question_patterns: simplify (2^3)^-2
calculate the power of a power
express (5^-2)^-3 in exponential form
what is the result of raising a power to another exponent
apply the power of a power law to simplify

solution_steps.explain: Find the inner and outer exponents.
Calculate the product of the two exponents.

concepts.title: Solving for Exponent in Multiplication
concepts.definition: Finding an unknown variable within an exponent by equating exponents of terms with identical bases.
concepts.key_idea: Equate the sum of exponents on one side to the exponent on the other side.
question_patterns: calculate m in the product 2^(m+2) * 2^3 = 2^8
what is the value of m for the product of powers
determine m such that the multiplication of powers equals the target
solve for the exponent m in the product equation

solution_steps.explain: Add the constant parts of the exponents on the left side.
Subtract the known sum from the target exponent on the right.

concepts.title: Solving for Exponent in Division
concepts.definition: Determining an unknown exponent by applying the quotient law and equating exponents across an equation.
concepts.key_idea: The unknown exponent minus the divisor exponent equals the result exponent.
question_patterns: find m if 5^m / 5^-3 = 5^5
calculate m in the division 3^m / 3^2 = 3^6
what is the value of m for the quotient of powers
determine m such that the ratio of powers equals the target
solve for the exponent m in the division equation

solution_steps.explain: Add the divisor exponent to the result exponent to find the dividend exponent.

concepts.title: Zero Exponent Law
concepts.definition: Any non-zero number raised to the power of zero is always equal to one.
concepts.key_idea: A zero power signifies unity regardless of the base value.
question_patterns: find the value of 5^0
what is any non-zero number raised to zero
calculate the value of x^0
simplify an expression with a zero exponent

solution_steps.explain: Any non-zero base to the power 0 is 1.

concepts.title: Standard Form for Small Numbers
concepts.definition: A method of writing very small decimals as a product of a number between 1 and 10 and a negative power of ten.
concepts.key_idea: Move the decimal point to create a single-digit integer part and count the shifts for the exponent.
question_patterns: write 0.000007 in standard form
express the diameter of a red blood cell in scientific notation
convert a very small decimal to standard form
how to represent small numbers using powers of 10
transform the number into standard notation

solution_steps.explain: Move the decimal point to the right until one non-zero digit is on the left.
Count how many places the decimal was moved to determine the negative exponent.

concepts.title: Conversion to Usual Form
concepts.definition: Expanding a number from standard scientific notation back into its full decimal or integer representation.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the decimal by the power of 10 to restore the original number.
question_patterns: express 3.52 * 10^5 in usual form
write 7.54 * 10^-4 as a decimal
convert the scientific notation to a standard number
what is the usual form of 3 * 10^-5
change from standard to usual notation

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the coefficient by 10 raised to the given exponent.

concepts.title: Comparing Magnitudes in Standard Form
concepts.definition: Determining the relative size of two numbers by calculating the ratio of their standard form representations.
concepts.key_idea: Divide the coefficients and subtract the exponents to compare scales.
question_patterns: compare the diameter of sun and earth
how many times bigger is a plant cell than a red blood cell
find the ratio of mass of earth to moon
calculate the relative size of two small objects
compare two numbers written in standard form

solution_steps.explain: Convert the first standard form number to its full value.
Convert the second standard form number to its full value.
Divide the first value by the second to find the comparison factor.

concepts.title: Combined Thickness Calculation
concepts.definition: Calculating the total height of a stack containing multiple types of items by summing their individual total thicknesses.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply count by thickness for each item type and then add the results.
question_patterns: find the total thickness of a stack of 5 books and 5 papers
calculate the height of a pile of items
what is the combined thickness of books and sheets
find the total height of the stack
compute the aggregate thickness of the given layers

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the number of books by the thickness of one book.
Multiply the number of paper sheets by the thickness of one sheet.
Add the total thickness of books and papers to get the final stack height.
